author: Labssis
quote: The game is bland, I wanted to steal Mandys car and I couldn't, I wanted to shoot at Donnie and couldn't, I wanted to hit a dude in the face near my home and couldn't. Why even have a karma system in what's essentially supposed to be a chaos simulator? At the end of the day THIS IS NOT GRAND THEFT AUTO. It's basically read dead redemption in the modern day. I don't think that would be bad if I was playing RDR2 but I'm not... I'm going back to San Andreas I need to clean my pallette
